notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR34: data-name-6 "indicates the status condition of the previously executed DISABLE, ENABLE, PURGE, RECEIVE, or SEND statement" per Table 1. Every statement runs through MessageControlSession#Statement, which stores the action's status at positions 32-33 via CommunicationArea#SetStatus; SetPath, Send, Purge and Receive return Table 1's I-O values. Probes at --std 85: ENABLE with a wrong KEY 40, ENABLE 00, DISABLE 00 then 15, SEND to a disabled terminal 10 (no action) for a message and a portion, PURGE with no portion 70, SEND WITH a zero indicator and no FROM 60, unknown terminal RECEIVE 21 and SEND 20, an unreadable mcs.json 91 on every statement; the witness covers 00/15/10.

next.reason: 1985: "The content of the data item referenced by data-name-6 indicates the status condition of the previously executed ... RECEIVE, or SEND"; 2023: "No communication description entry; the Communication module is absent from the 2023 candidates". The 2023 standard lacks the communication description entry and its status key. No candidate covers CD entries or RECEIVE/SEND status, so the feature was dropped.
